time_backward_pass: time the backward pass of a PyTorch operation using time_backward with gradient hooks
time_forward_and_backward: time both forward and backward passes of a PyTorch operation using timeit
use_timer_context_manager: use the Timer context manager to measure execution time of nested code blocks
get_timer_stats: get mean and standard deviation timing statistics for a named Timer key using get_stats
reset_timer_times: reset all recorded timing data by calling Timer.reset to clear the times dictionary
